answer: Admission runs through a scarce-slot mooring auction: each epoch the network issues a fixed number of non-transferable wharf berths, and every new identity must win one by burning stake. Since berth supply is capped, M sybil personas bid against each other, the clearing price ripples upward quadratically, so bulk creation costs O(M^2) while earning power stays O(M). Winning collateral vests in shale-like strata, one layer released per epoch of honest conduct; any detected sybil cluster forfeits every unfrozen layer, so the attacker's sunk bids never return.
